sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface detection confirmed by anti-FLAG antibody binding on intact, non-permeabilised live cells and by cell-surface immunoprecipitation (L2, L4). No channel-function assay (e.g., BK-channel modulation) is reported in the ledger clips.
sites.rationale: The signal peptide spans residues 1–26 (last residue A at position 26); the mature N-terminus begins at Q27. L1 explicitly places the FLAG tag after the cleaved signal peptide and before the LRRNT unit, which maps unambiguously to insert_after_residue=26. Python verification confirms residue 26='A' and residue 27='Q'. The tag is on the extracellular face (235 residues from the TM boundary at 262), confirmed by live-cell surface staining (L2) and cell-surface immunoprecipitation (L4). L3 further validates topology by showing the C-terminal FLAG is inaccessible extracellularly. L1/L2/L4 (PMC8892010): FLAG epitope tag introduced at the N-terminus of full-length γ1 (LRRC26) in a membrane-anchored construct, positioned after the cleaved signal peptide (residues 1–26) and immediately before the LRRNT unit (mature residue 27). Expressed in mammalian cells; live, non-permeabilised cells probed with anti-FLAG antibody and used for cell-surface immunoprecipitation.

sources.claim: We introduced the FLAG peptide tag to the γ subunits’ N termini, located after the cleaved signal peptides and immediately in front of the LRRNT unit and C termini, respectively.

literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) from PMC8892010 describe the same experimental construct: N-terminally FLAG-tagged full-length LRRC26 with the tag placed after signal-peptide cleavage. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion or any other junction. The C-terminal FLAG construct was tested and found intracellular (L3), recorded in other_positions. No functional assay for LRRC26's role as a BK-channel auxiliary subunit is reported in the ledger clips, so validation_level is surface_only rather than surface_and_function.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminally FLAG-tagged γ1 (LRRC26) was not immunoprecipitated from intact cell membranes by extracellular anti-FLAG antibody, demonstrating that the C-terminus is intracellular and inaccessible from the extracellular face.
